# Afsnit 341: Sådan tackler du regnskaberne

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Investeringspodcasten med Hansen og Larsen. It previews the Q3 reporting season for the Danish C25 index and expects fewer upgrades than in Q2; A.P. Møller-Mærsk is the only company where consensus sits clearly above guidance. Genmab is the bright spot after strong data for epcoritamab and Rina-S. DSV, Coloplast, GN Store Nord and Novo Nordisk are described as hit by loss of confidence and weak share prices. Consumer stocks are under pressure from high rates and inflation, while Vestas' margin recovery and Rockwool's US capacity limits are key items to watch.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GMAB — Genmab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Very strong epcoritamab and Rina-S data; Acasunlimab/PETOSEMTAMAB readouts due in Q4 with combined peak sales of USD 8-9bn.

#### Reasoning

The guest calls the epcoritamab data the best he has seen in this indication and a 'rebirth' for Genmab. Three pipeline drugs with combined estimated peak sales of USD 8-9bn could cover the patent cliff from 2029. He expects 'the party to continue' in Q4 as more data arrives.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4/Q1 phase 3 data disappoint
- if the head-and-neck data with Keytruda disappoint
- if the pipeline cannot fill the patent gap from 2029

> *"Så der må jeg sige, at festen fortsætter måske nok her i FK4, når der kommer yderligere data på de her tre stoffer."*

---

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest has repeatedly bought on the ~40% fall and thinks the decline is overdone given the fundamentals. Technical analysts see no bottom yet.

#### Reasoning

The guest (Helge) holds the stock and keeps adding on weakness. He sees Schenker and Road issues as too small to justify the fall, while sea, air and logistics are doing well. Confidence in the Road integration and synergies is what decides the case. Q3 on 21 Oct is the catalyst, but the technicals look weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 on 21 Oct shows further Road/Schenker integration problems
- if synergy targets or timeline are cut
- if the technical selling continues without a bottom

> *"Og jeg har jo sagt det et par gange efterhånden, at jeg har købt på det her kurstag"*

---

### 🟠 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Consensus is >10% above the guidance midpoint; a third upgrade is likely when Maersk reports in early November.

#### Reasoning

Maersk has beaten guidance twice this year, freight rates remain high despite worries about new ship capacity, and the hosts expect another upgrade with Q3. This is a short-term positive catalyst, though the long-term structural worry about new capacity remains.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no upgrade comes with Q3
- if freight rates fall as new capacity arrives

> *"de har jo slået forventningerne to gange nu, og de gør det nok også en tredje gang"*

---

### 🟠 PNDORA — Pandora | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest expects Q3 on the good side after strong campaigns, but is nervous about weaker US consumer demand in Q4.

#### Reasoning

The shares have roughly doubled from about 400 and have held up better than other consumer stocks. Q3 campaigns may produce a positive surprise, but US consumer weakness, silver prices and the US share of sales (about a third) are risks for Q4. Platinum jewellery is a mitigating factor to monitor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US consumer weakness shows in Q4
- if silver prices keep rising

> *"Jeg tror faktisk, at regnskabet kan være lidt til den gode side."*

---

### 🟠 COLO-B — Coloplast | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Has underperformed; needs faster growth, a Kerecis breakthrough and buybacks to re-rate. Q4/full-year report expected around December.

#### Reasoning

The host lists three conditions for investors to turn positive: faster growth, commercial proof for Kerecis, and a buyback alongside the dividend. The products are strong but held back by reimbursement policy, and the new CEO needs to be more shareholder-friendly. Until these conditions are met the stock keeps slipping back.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth fails to accelerate
- if Kerecis keeps underdelivering
- if no buyback is announced

> *"hvis investorerne skal blive meget mere positive på Coloplast, så skal der 1. væksten accelerere."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Oral Wegovy pill is doing well, but analysts keep cutting targets and the gap to Lilly is widening. Q3 report on 4 Nov.

#### Reasoning

Guest is positive on the pill rollout and believes milder, more tolerable treatments may win long-term because of high dropout rates. The host notes that the share price is driven by analyst cuts and by investor preference for the biggest weight loss, which favours Lilly. The thesis has no near-term catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if analysts keep cutting targets
- if guidance is lowered again on 4 Nov
- if the oral pill uptake stalls

> *"analytikerne bliver ved med at trykke kursmålene ned. Der kommer ikke flere positive anbefalinger."*

---

### ⛔ GN — GN Store Nord | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Poor execution, distrust of management. Sale of Hearing to Amplifon leaves the weaker Enterprise and gaming units; unclear use of cash.

#### Reasoning

Hosts cite years of poor execution, an overpaid SteelSeries deal (about DKK 8bn), and the sale of the higher-multiple, stable hearing business, leaving a volatile Enterprise/gaming business. Possible re-rating triggers are limited without clarity on capital allocation.

> *"Der er så stor mistillid til den, og der kan jo også være en mistillid til ledelsen."*

---

### 🟠 VWS — Vestas | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Strong Q2 and a raised margin guide; investors are looking for signs that an EBIT margin of 10% or more is achievable in 2027.

#### Reasoning

Q2 margin guidance was raised and investors have turned more positive. Profitability drives the stock; Q3 and the 2027 outlook will test whether a margin of 10% or more is credible. Risks are raw materials, logistics and service-business margins.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 2027 outlook does not support a ~10% EBIT margin
- if service margins disappoint
- if raw material or logistics costs squeeze margins

> *"det er jo det, investorerne vil prøve at spejde efter helgen, om det stadigvæk er en mulighed"*

---

### 🟠 ROCK-B — Rockwool | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Long-term strong compounder but fell about 15% after a small, price-driven upgrade. US capacity is full despite data-centre demand.

#### Reasoning

Strong US demand, including from data centres, cannot be captured until new plants are built. Shipping the product is expensive and costs about 1pp of margin. Energy is largely hedged, so energy-price swings reflect risk premium more than real costs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US capacity constraints persist longer
- if transport costs keep eroding margin
- if price-driven growth fades

> *"Men det hjælper jo ikke, hvis du ikke kan producere det."*
